definitions.gloss: to arrange flowers, to do ikebana
definitions.explanation: To arrange cut flowers or branches in a vase or container, especially in the traditional Japanese art of flower arrangement (生け花).

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧、⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My mother arranges flowers in the entryway every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{摘|つ}んだ→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}けた。
examples.english: I arranged flowers I picked from the garden in the vase in the Japanese-style room.

notes:
{生|い}ける means to arrange cut flowers or branches in a vase, especially in the tradition of ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧ (ikebana). The focus is on artful placement rather than simply putting flowers in water.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}ける

ASPECT (ている):
{生|い}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes flowers that are currently arranged/displayed: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|い}けて⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (flowers are arranged in the entryway).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}ける: to arrange flowers
- ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}ける: to arrange in a vase
- ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}ける: to arrange flowers in the tokonoma alcove

WRITING:
Usually written {生|い}ける. Sometimes written {活|い}ける with the same meaning.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{生|い}け{花|ばな}→生け花：05409_ikebana⟧: ikebana, the art of Japanese flower arrangement
- ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧: flower vase

WATCH OUT:
Different word from colloquial ⟦いける→いける：06957_ikeru⟧ (to be doable, to be okay).
